description: Image Description: The image depicts a public restroom with a clean and modern design. The walls are covered in small, square tiles arranged in a grid pattern, featuring a mix of beige and light brown tones that create a checkered effect. A large mirror spans the length of the wall above a bright orange countertop, which houses two white, oval-shaped sinks. Each sink is equipped with a chrome faucet featuring separate hot and cold handles. Above the sinks, mounted on the tiled wall, are various fixtures
